text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 6 से 8 तक ‘The Wise Man-I’ पढ़ो। फिर सवालों के जवाब दो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 6 se 8 tak ‘The Wise Man-I’ padho. Phir sawaalon ke jawab do.
text.en: Read ‘The Wise Man-I’ on pages 6 to 8 of your book. Then answer the questions.

steps.question: Why did the horse trainer and his wife decide to sell the horse?

questionMeaning.hi: घोड़ा सिखाने वाले और उसकी पत्नी ने घोड़ा बेचने का फ़ैसला क्यों किया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Ghoda sikhaane waale aur uski patni ne ghoda bechne ka faisla kyon kiya?

options: Because the horse ate a lot of fodder.
Because the horse was very old.
Because the Nawab asked for it.
steps.answer: Because the horse ate a lot of fodder.
steps.modelAnswer: They decided to sell the horse because it ate a lot of fodder and it was very expensive to feed it.

modelMeaning.hi: उन्होंने घोड़ा बेचने का फ़ैसला किया क्योंकि वह बहुत चारा खाता था और उसे खिलाना बहुत महँगा था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Unhone ghoda bechne ka faisla kiya kyonki woh bahut chaara khaata tha aur use khilaana bahut mehnga tha.

steps.question: Where did Bhola go to sell the horse?
steps.modelAnswer: Bhola went to the market to sell the horse.

steps.question: Whom did he meet first?
steps.modelAnswer: He first met a man with a donkey.

modelMeaning.hi: वह सबसे पहले एक गधे वाले आदमी से मिला।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Woh sabse pehle ek gadhe waale aadmi se mila.

steps.question: Why did Bhola think of buying a sheep?

questionMeaning.hi: भोला ने भेड़ लेने के बारे में क्यों सोचा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bhola ne bhed lene ke baare mein kyon socha?

options: He thought his wife would like a sheep in place of a donkey.
He wanted wool for a sweater.
steps.answer: He thought his wife would like a sheep in place of a donkey.
steps.modelAnswer: Bhola thought of getting a sheep because he felt his wife would like a sheep in place of a donkey.

modelMeaning.hi: भोला ने भेड़ लेने का सोचा क्योंकि उसे लगा कि उसकी पत्नी को गधे की जगह भेड़ पसंद आएगी।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bhola ne bhed lene ka socha kyonki use laga ki uski patni ko gadhe ki jagah bhed pasand aayegi.

steps.question: What did the girl having the green mangoes ask the horse trainer?

questionMeaning.hi: हरे आम वाली लड़की ने भोला से क्या पूछा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Hare aam waali ladki ne Bhola se kya poochha?

options: She asked whether the hen lays eggs.
She asked the price of the hen.
She asked where his wife lived.
steps.answer: She asked whether the hen lays eggs.
steps.modelAnswer: The girl asked the horse trainer whether his hen lays eggs.

modelMeaning.hi: लड़की ने पूछा कि क्या उसकी मुर्गी अंडे देती है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Ladki ne poochha ki kya uski murgi ande deti hai.

text.hi: अब किताब का True/False: वाक्य सही है तो True, गलत है तो False चुनो।
text.hinglish: Ab kitaab ka True/False: vaakya sahi hai to True, galat hai to False chuno.
text.en: Now the book's True or False: pick True if the sentence is right, False if it is wrong.

steps.question: True or false? Bhola's wife was Asha.

questionMeaning.hi: भोला की पत्नी का नाम आशा था।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bhola ki patni ka naam Asha tha.

modelMeaning.hi: गलत। भोला की पत्नी शांति थी।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Galat. Bhola ki patni Shanti thi.

steps.question: True or false? Bhola spent little money for feeding his horse.

questionMeaning.hi: भोला घोड़े को खिलाने में कम पैसे ख़र्च करता था।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bhola ghode ko khilaane mein kam paise kharch karta tha.

steps.modelAnswer: False. It was very expensive to feed the horse.

modelMeaning.hi: गलत। घोड़े को खिलाना बहुत महँगा था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Galat. Ghode ko khilaana bahut mehnga tha.

steps.question: True or false? His wife loved to eat mango chutney.

questionMeaning.hi: उसकी पत्नी को आम की चटनी बहुत पसंद थी।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Uski patni ko aam ki chatni bahut pasand thi.

steps.question: True or false? The girl had a basket full of green mangoes.

questionMeaning.hi: लड़की के पास हरे आमों से भरी टोकरी थी।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Ladki ke paas hare aamon se bhari tokri thi.

steps.question: True or false? Bhola gave the sheep to the girl in exchange for her green mangoes.

questionMeaning.hi: भोला ने हरे आमों के बदले लड़की को भेड़ दी।
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bhola ne hare aamon ke badle ladki ko bhed di.

steps.modelAnswer: False. Bhola gave the hen to the girl.

modelMeaning.hi: गलत। भोला ने लड़की को मुर्गी दी थी।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Galat. Bhola ne ladki ko murgi di thi.
